package.name: wojtek_benchmark
package.description:
Real-robot benchmark instrumentation for Wojtek: AprilTag-based ground-truth pose tracking ("motion-capture-lite"). Three floor tags in an L define the world frame and scale, one tag on the robot gives its pose in that frame, and benchmark runs are scored against the same course scenarios as the simulation battery.
config/apriltags.yaml is the single source of truth for tag semantics (an AprilTag itself only encodes an ID). tags/*.pdf are committed generated artifacts: regenerate with scripts/generate_tags.py after editing the yaml, never hand-edit them.
